CeraVe Renewing SA Cleanser And Hydrating Cleanser with Salicylic Acid & Ceramides – 237ml

Reveal smoother, softer, and healthier-looking skin with the CeraVe Renewing SA Cleanser. Specially developed with dermatologists, this gentle yet effective cleanser exfoliates and renews the skin’s surface without compromising its natural protective barrier.

Formulated with salicylic acid, it helps remove dead skin cells and unclog pores for a refined texture, while ceramides restore and maintain essential moisture. Its non-comedogenic, non-drying, and non-irritating formula makes it ideal for daily use, leaving your skin clean, refreshed, and comfortable.

Perfect for normal skin, this 237ml cleanser ensures a clear, smooth, and healthy-looking complexion every day.

CeraVe Hydrating Cleanser with Hyaluronic Acid & Ceramides – 237ml

The CeraVe Hydrating Cleanser is a dermatologist-developed, non-foaming face wash designed to gently cleanse while replenishing hydration. Perfect for normal to dry skin, it effectively removes dirt, oil, and makeup without stripping away the skin’s natural moisture.

Powered by essential ceramides to restore the skin’s protective barrier and hyaluronic acid to lock in long-lasting hydration, this cleanser leaves skin feeling soft, smooth, and refreshed. Its fragrance-free, non-comedogenic, and non-irritating formula makes it suitable for even the most sensitive skin.
